gaps.lead: The committee probably won't change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: probably won't = it is (highly) unlikely that.

gaps.lead: You'll fail your exam if you don't revise.
gaps.explanation: unless + present simple = if you don't.

gaps.lead: It wasn't necessary for her to bring any food — there was plenty.
gaps.explanation: needn't have + participle = it wasn't necessary, but she did it.

gaps.lead: He can't be in Spain — I saw him here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — I saw him this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't/cannot possibly be = it is impossible that he is.

gaps.lead: A professional photographer took the couple's portraits.
gaps.sentence: The couple ___ by a professional photographer.
gaps.explanation: Arranging for a professional to do it: had their portraits taken.

gaps.lead: He finally succeeded in solving the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.

gaps.answer: sure how I would have reacted
gaps.lead: It's difficult to know what my reaction would have been in that situation.
gaps.hint: difficult to know = not sure how
gaps.explanation: 'I'm not sure how I would have reacted' — a hypothetical past.

gaps.lead: I rarely drink coffee in the evening.
gaps.explanation: be (not) used to something = (not) accustomed to it.
